definitions: To risk everything on a single venture or opportunity.
To concentrate all of one's resources or efforts into one area, thereby increasing vulnerability to failure.
examples: Don't put all your eggs in one basket by investing solely in that one stock.
She decided not to put all her eggs in one basket and applied to several universities.
It's risky to put all your eggs in one basket when starting a new business.
lemma: to put all your eggs in one basket
synonyms: to stake everything on one throw
source: to put all your eggs in one basket
